prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a single production-ready transparent 2D relic icon, Junna Hoshimi's green bow gemstone from Revue Starlight, now separated from its mounting.
Input 1 is the OFFICIAL WEAPON DESIGN SHEET: use the gem enlargement labeled 宝石のUP as the shape and cut reference. Input 2 is a STYLE reference from a previous draft only.
User's absolute requirement: ONLY THE GEMSTONE. Remove ALL gold, metal, base, mount, bow, leaf fingers, chains and surrounding objects. The jewel must have a fully visible closed lower edge.
Subject: a broad slightly oval convex emerald-green cut jewel, near-round rounded polygon silhouette, shown front-on with a slight tilt left and subtle dimensional thickness. Around 12-18 broad irregular triangular crystalline facets which converge into a pinwheel/star-like internal reflection, as in the official enlargement. Follow the rounded polygon outline on the design sheet; do not use a long pointed diamond, square emerald cut, teardrop, orb or ring.
Style: polished hand-painted Slay the Spire 2 fantasy inventory art with a clean dark forest green outer contour, bold planar light/dark facet groups, restrained painterly finish. Saturated emerald greens, deep bottle green shaded facets on the lower right, luminous mint and pale lime facets on upper left. One modest tiny off-center glint; gem remains rich GREEN throughout. Broad clean shapes read strongly at 32px. Avoid fine lines, microtexture and photographic realism.
Composition: centered only gemstone occupies 78-82% of a square transparent canvas. Keep margins all around. Real transparent alpha, no shadow, no background, no frame, no text, no sparkles outside. All metal and gold elements absolutely absent.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied isolated green gem icon. Make the upgraded relic "燃烧宝石" (Burning Gem) for Junna, keeping this exact gemstone.
LOCK shape, size, position, orientation, outer silhouette and ALL facet boundaries. The same object must occupy exactly the same place on the square canvas. Absolutely no mount, metal, base, gold, bow or other physical object.
Change only light: make the central facet intersection blaze with intense concentrated pale mint-white light, send 4-6 broad sharp light wedges along the existing facet directions, increase mint-green internal reflected light, retain the outer ring of rich dark emerald facets and dark contour so gem geometry stays readable. A few short crisp cyan/green rays may extend a little outside the gem, with a close-fitting restrained transparent glow. Leave clear transparent margins on all sides: every ray fully contained at least 5% inside the canvas edge. No detached star objects. No orange flames. Green blazing brilliance inside the stone. High contrast hand-painted fantasy roguelike icon style, clean broad facet colors, no microtexture. The upgraded gem must clearly look brighter than the starter but remain visibly green rather than all white. Keep physical gem silhouette and facet geometry identical to supplied icon. Real transparent alpha background, no floor or shadow, no frame, no text.
